description: Kaboom Crew player avatar. S104 KABOOM-MIGRATE-PREFABS: the player root no longer carries a MeshRenderer — kaboom-crew bootstrap calls spawnBomberTree(playerId, recipe) which spawns a 19-entity procedural tree (1 root + 9 pivots + 10 mesh parts) parented to this entity. The procbomber generator lives at examples/procbomber-bench/src/ — this project imports it directly.
